evidence.quote: Participant with histologically or cytologically confirmed diagnosis of advanced unresectable and/or metastatic solid tumors
Have measurable disease per RECIST 1.1 as assessed by the local site investigator/radiology
Has received prior platinum-based chemotherapy and progressed within 4 weeks of initiating therapy (platinum-refractory disease)

labels.note: Phase 1 solid tumor ADC listing ovarian cancer; carboplatin/paclitaxel 'did very little', so whether she was platinum-refractory by this definition is unclear.
